capabilities: Mark File Explorer items whose files are open in the workspace
Add one marker per open instance of a file
Activate the corresponding tab when a marker is clicked
disambiguation: Distinct from plugins that reveal the current tab in the File Explorer; it marks every open file instance, one marker per tab.
extras: A README screenshot showing the plugin in action alongside the author's Continuous Mode plugin was removed during text extraction; visual behavior is inferred from the text.
intentEvidence: different from the functionality that plugins designed to reveal the current tab in the file explorer perform
problem: Obsidian's File Explorer does not show which files are open across multiple tabs, so it is hard to tell at a glance which notes are already open.

relations.evidence: This screenshot includes some behavior handled by my "Continuous Mode" plugin

summary: File Explorer enhancement that adds a marker to each file explorer item that is currently open in a workspace tab.
